  "meta": {
    "title": "Token bucket in a shared store",
    "topicClass": "internals",
    "format": "full",
    "targetLengthSec": 90
  },
  "story": {
    "devices": [
      "real_incident",
      "planted_question",
      "versus_split",
      "failure_before_fix",
      "what_breaks",
      "race_reveal",
      "spec_card_ending"
    ],
    "runningExample": "A checkout request from key:7781:search follows the limiter through Hollowmere's gateways, the shared store, and the failure policies.",
    "chapters": [
      {
        "id": "ch_problem",
        "title": "The problem"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch_bucket",
        "title": "Token bucket"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch_shared",
        "title": "Shared store"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch_slow",
        "title": "Slow store"
      },
      {
        "id": "ch_fail",
        "title": "Failure mode"
      }
    ],
    "beats": [
      {
        "id": "beat_hook",
        "chapterId": "ch_problem",
        "intent": "Open on Larkspur Pay's limiter store after failover: store calls hit 80 ms and checkout traffic left at 40× the contracted rate, making the problem concrete.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-20",
          "fact-21"
        ],
        "hookNumberIds": [
          "num-21",
          "num-23"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "versus_split",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "versus_split"
        ],
        "newTerms": [],
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team, 14 March 2025"
      },
      {
        "id": "beat_bucket",
        "chapterId": "ch_bucket",
        "intent": "Show a token bucket with its two fields and one request spending a token, while the screen asks why the bucket cannot live on each gateway.",
        "device": "planted_question",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-1",
          "fact-2"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": [
          "token bucket"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "beat_fixed_window",
        "chapterId": "ch_bucket",
        "intent": "Show the fixed-minute counter allowing a burst of 2× the limit across the boundary, then the bucket replacing it so bursts stay bounded by capacity.",
        "device": "versus_split",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-9",
          "fact-10",
          "num-6"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "versus_split",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "versus_split"
        ],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "beat_shared_store",
        "chapterId": "ch_shared",
        "intent": "Show one client's requests spread over 24 gateway nodes: per-node buckets let it get 24× the limit, so the bucket is moved into one shared store.",
        "device": "failure_before_fix",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-7",
          "num-3"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "pipeline",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "fan_out"
        ],
        "newTerms": [
          "shared store"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "beat_atomic",
        "chapterId": "ch_shared",
        "intent": "Show two gateway nodes reading the same count and both seeing one token; the shared store runs read-refill-write as one atomic script so only one spends it.",
        "device": "what_breaks",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-6"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "hub_spoke",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "atomic_lock"
        ],
        "newTerms": [
          "atomic script"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "beat_timeout_race",
        "chapterId": "ch_slow",
        "intent": "Show the store call running 80 ms against the 50 ms timeout: the slower call trips the failure path, so a slow store changes limiter behaviour.",
        "device": "race_reveal",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-14",
          "num-16",
          "num-21"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "versus_split",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "versus_split"
        ],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "beat_policy_split",
        "chapterId": "ch_slow",
        "intent": "Compare the same store failure under fail closed (503) and fail open (local limits multiply), revealing why the policy is the real decision.",
        "device": "versus_split",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-15",
          "fact-16",
          "fact-22"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "versus_split",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      },
      {
        "id": "beat_incident",
        "chapterId": "ch_fail",
        "intent": "Show Larkspur's 40 checkout instances each enforcing the full limit, driving about 40× the contracted rate to the provider and failing 31% of checkouts for 47 minutes.",
        "device": "real_incident",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-19",
          "fact-21",
          "fact-23",
          "num-18",
          "num-19",
          "num-22",
          "num-23"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "pipeline",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [
          "fan_out"
        ],
        "newTerms": [],
        "source": "Larkspur Pay platform team, 14 March 2025"
      },
      {
        "id": "beat_spec_card",
        "chapterId": "ch_fail",
        "intent": "Close with the design boiled down to a three-line spec: one shared store, atomic read-refill-write, fail closed for downstream limits.",
        "device": "spec_card_ending",
        "targetSec": 10,
        "factIds": [
          "fact-25"
        ],
        "layoutMode": "centered_focus",
        "suggestedPatternIds": [],
        "newTerms": []
      }
    ],
    "plantedQuestion": {
      "text": "Why not keep a bucket on each gateway?",
      "beatId": "beat_bucket",
      "payoffBeatId": "beat_shared_store"
    },
    "ending": {
      "kind": "spec_card_ending",
      "cta": "Share this with someone still counting per calendar minute.",
      "specCard": {
        "lines": [
          "One shared store",
          "Atomic read-refill-write",
          "Fail closed downstream"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
